title: Have a person judge the unjudged pictures that land in the classifier's top 100
body: When the classifier fitted on 100 yes/no answers ranks the whole library, about two thirds of its top 100 are pictures nobody has ever answered on, even for tags that only a few percent of pictures carry. No test that reuses old answers can say whether those pictures are right. In the person-judged top-100 test (idea 5), record separately how many of the never-judged pictures in the top 100 the person confirms. Optionally do this for the classifier with and without 300 background pictures, on two or three rare tags. If the never-judged pictures are mostly wrong, background negatives (or something like them) are still worth another look. If they are mostly right, the old-answer tests understate the classifier.
